   • CVR: 0.85% → 0.71% (-16%, down (drag))
   • AOV: 1,854 → 1,690 EGP (-9%, down (drag))

   *Read:* *CVR* fell -16%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *-400,632 EGP of revenue at the same clicks*.
     That drove ROAS -28%.
     Revenue +7% because spend +48%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *Nesmaa the Mommy eats - stories thermos*, its CVR went 6.67%→0.12% on 2,937 EGP spend (~44% of the swing).
